title: External Engagement Officer

When you see the world as we do, you see the chance to help the world take better care of its resources, and help it become a better place for everyone. It's why we're looking for someone who's just as committed as we are, to push for genuine change and bring our ambition of Ecological Transformation to life.
We know that everyone here at Veolia can help us work alongside our communities, look after the environment, and contribute to our inclusive culture.
What we can offer you;

- Stream - Employee financial wellbeing support: early access to your earned pay, savings, budgeting, financial coaching & reward

What you'll be doing
An exciting opportunity has arisen for an External Engagement Officer to design and deliver strategic campaigns to support local authorities to promote recycling and waste minimisation.
As an External Engagement Officer, you will develop engaging digital social media content for local authorities in a number of formats, including video, and will have the chance to make a real impact on recycling rates by communicating with residents using innovative digital techniques. You will also lead on reactive and proactive press for your area, with the opportunity to identify and develop good news stories throughout the year.
You will support your team by communicating with residents to solve issues, including delivering face-to-face community engagement activities to achieve project goals, and responding to resident complaints on social media. This could include identifying target groups and developing appropriate strategies to deliver key messages, delivering community events, and door-knocking target areas.
You will have the experience of working in a team to deliver projects and will be confident in managing a varied workload.
You will need to be a detail oriented and creative individual who is confident in communicating concisely and clearly.
This role will involve working in both Watford and Kings Cross in a hybrid manner. Some evening and weekend work will be required on occasion and a full driving licence and experience of driving in the UK is preferable.
The experience you will need
Essential:
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Understand how to utilise social media campaigns and tailor communication to different audiences
- Confident in developing content in multiple formats, and will possess filming and basic video editing skills
- Have excellent attention to detail, planning and organisational skills and a proven ability to prioritise workloads and multi-task
- Experience of complaint resolution and speaking to the public

Desirable:
- Knowledge of the recycling sector
- Experience working with local authorities
- Experience designing and delivering social media, social advertising and digital campaigns
- Experience dealing with media proactively and reactively
- Full UK Driving Licence and experience of driving in the UK

You will be able to work unsupervised when necessary but will also be happy collaborating with teammates. You will be available to work weekends and evenings occasionally as and when it is required.

What's next?

Apply today, so we can make a difference for generations to come.

We're proud to have been named as one of The Sunday Times Best Places to Work for three consecutive years in 2023, 2024 and 2025. This consistent recognition reflects our commitment to our people, demonstrating that Veolia is not just transforming the environment, we're also transforming what it means to have a rewarding, purposeful career.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant (Accounts and Billing) Location: Watford (Hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 days working from home)
Contract Type: Temp to Perm
Availability: Immediately available candidates only
Salary Range: £32,000 to £35,000 per annum

Role Purpose
To support the day-to-day operation of the finance function through accurate transaction processing, reconciliations, customer billing, and collections. The role maintains accurate financial records, resolves routine queries, and supports the wider finance team, managing routine work independently with appropriate review and escalation of complex matters.

Key Responsibilities
- Process supplier invoices, checking that the required approvals are in place and applying accurate nominal ledger coding.
- Process employee expenses, checking coding and uploading transactions into the finance system.
- Process credit card expenses, ensuring accurate nominal coding and application of established VAT treatments.
- Record bank receipts and payments in Sage, complete bank reconciliations, and investigate or escalate outstanding differences.
- Maintain subscription billing and collection records, ensuring that direct debit mandates in GoCardless and payment arrangements in Stripe align with invoices in the relevant billing systems, including Stripe, Naviga, and Xero.
- Monitor failed customer payments and follow the agreed process to resolve collection issues.
- Allocate customer receipts from the bank account to invoices in Naviga and investigate unallocated cash.
- Reconcile billing, payment-provider, and accounting records to bank receipts, investigating missing allocations, duplicate entries, and unexplained differences.
- Manage the finance inbox, responding to and resolving routine queries and referring matters to the appropriate colleague where required.
- Prepare national statistics survey responses, coordinating review of unusual definitions or matters requiring judgement.
- Maintain clear supporting records and follow up unresolved items to completion.
- Assist the wider finance team with duties and ad hoc projects consistent with the scope of the role.

Scope and Accountability
Manage routine processing, reconciliations, and queries independently within agreed procedures and deadlines. Escalate complex accounting or VAT matters and issues requiring approval to the appropriate finance colleague.
Person Specification
Essential Experience, Knowledge, and Skills
- Relevant practical finance experience covering purchase ledger, expenses, customer receipts, and bank reconciliations, with the ability to manage routine work with normal supervision.
- Sound working knowledge of bookkeeping, including double-entry principles and the relationship between invoices, credit notes, payments, receipts, and ledger balances.
- Experience investigating reconciliation differences, payment discrepancies, and unallocated receipts, with appropriate follow-up and escalation.
- Ability to apply established nominal and VAT coding and recognise transactions requiring technical review.
- Confidence comparing and reconciling data across accounting, billing, and payment systems.
- Practical Excel skills, including filters, lookups, SUMIFS, and duplicate checks.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to resolve queries with suppliers, customers, and colleagues.
- Strong attention to detail, organisation, and ability to manage recurring deadlines and competing priorities.
- Sound judgement about when to resolve an issue independently and when to seek approval or technical support.

Qualifications
- AAT Level 3 completed or in progress, or equivalent practical knowledge and experience.

Desirable Experience and Skills
- Experience in a subscription or recurring billing environment.
- Experience using GoCardless or Stripe for collections and reconciliation.
- Experience using Sage or Xero, and familiarity with Naviga.
- Experience working across multiple finance or billing systems and following up failed payments.
- Experience completing Office for National Statistics surveys or similar business returns.
- Ability to use Excel pivot tables.

title: Operations Co-Ordinator
description:
We are currently recruiting for an exciting opportunity as an Operations Co-Ordinator to join a growing and dynamic team based in Watford, Hertfordshire. This role offers the chance to play a key part in a thriving international business, supporting the full lifecycle of customer order fulfilment, from initial enquiries and order updates through to delivery coordination and issue resolution. The client is renowned for delivering end-to-end procurement, supply chain management, logistics and financial solutions to businesses operating across the mining and energy industries, supported by a global network of suppliers and service providers.

You will work closely with internal departments and external partners to ensure customers receive a seamless and professional service throughout the order process. Acting as a key point of contact for customers, you will provide regular updates, manage expectations and coordinate with the wider Operations, Accounts and Warehouse teams to ensure goods are delivered on time and in full. You will also liaise with third-party logistics providers to arrange transport, packaging, inspections and other services in line with customer requirements. This role is ideal for someone who is customer-focused, proactive and keen to develop within a busy international operations environment.

You will be responsible for monitoring customer orders, providing accurate updates, preparing invoices and supporting documentation, and coordinating domestic and international logistics. A key part of the role will involve investigating and resolving discrepancies raised by customers or internal teams, maintaining accurate order records and escalating issues where necessary to ensure a swift resolution. Going above and beyond for customers will be essential, so excellent communication skills, attention to detail and a professional, solutions-focused approach are paramount. Previous experience in customer service, order processing, account management or operations administration would be beneficial, while knowledge of logistics or CRM systems would be an advantage.

This is a full-time, office-based position in Watford, Hertfordshire, working Monday to Friday, 8:30am-5:00pm. The role offers a salary of 26,000 - 29,000 per annum, dependent on experience, plus a generous monthly bonus scheme following successful completion of probation. Additional benefits include 20 days' annual leave, increasing with service to 25 days, five personal days, a wellness day, your birthday off, group life assurance, a pension scheme, subsidised on-site meals, paid sick days and regular office socials. If this role sounds like something of interest, we would love to hear from you!
